_comment: ADDITIVE overlay for specimens/manhattan.json (base NOT modified). Web-grounded 2026-06-10. now_extension = 2024-2026 refresh (base ends ~1950s-hardening); entity_lifecycles = real born/founded/conceived dates the base lacks; harvest_dates = consolidation dating for base harvest/action-space items; rival_fates = decay/absorption fates for relatives.edges rivals; theory_dna = DISCLOSED ESTIMATES of load-bearing shares (historiographic + spend-share proxies, confidence <=0.6, NEVER measured bits — gain_v2 numbers do not exist for this specimen). All ids match base ids exactly; cultural_harvest items (no base ids) keyed by domain, action_spaces_unlocked by index.

now_extension.what: 'Oppenheimer' (2023) wins 7 Academy Awards incl. Best Picture — the conflicted-bomb-maker archetype (cultural_harvest[art]) back at the center of world culture

Microsoft-Constellation 20-yr PPA to RESTART Three Mile Island Unit 1 as Crane Clean Energy Center (835 MW) to power AI data centers; DOE $1bn loan Nov 2025 — h-nuclear-power revived by AI compute demand

Nobel Peace Prize to Nihon Hidankyo (hibakusha of Hiroshima/Nagasaki) 'for efforts to achieve a world free of nuclear weapons' — the witness-testimony wing of h-scientists-responsibility honored on the 80th-anniversary eve

US-China Economic & Security Review Commission recommends Congress fund a 'Manhattan Project-like' AGI program — cultural_harvest[other] ('a Manhattan Project for ___') re-fired at top policy level for AI

DOE frames nuclear-renaissance-for-the-AI-race as 'Manhattan Project 2.0'; federal push to expand nuclear capacity — the weld's NAME reused by its own descendant institution (DOE is the AEC's successor)
80th anniversary of Trinity; 80th of Hiroshima/Nagasaki 6 & 9 Aug 2025 — global commemorations of the consummation events
Trump instructs the Pentagon to resume US nuclear-weapons testing 'on an equal basis' with rivals — first move against the 33-year post-1992 moratorium; Putin orders counter-test proposals Nov 2025
Doomsday Clock set to 85 seconds to midnight — closest ever (4s closer than 2025; nuclear + AI + bio cited). The 1947 harvest instrument (act-bulletin) still firing in the NOW
New START EXPIRES with no successor — first time since 1972 with no legally-binding US-Russia strategic limits; the arms-control limb of h-deterrence decays

theory_dna._comment: DISCLOSED ESTIMATES, not measurements. Shares = how much of the consummated child each parents_full lobe load-bears, normalized to 1.0. Anchors: spend-share (>80% of ~$2bn on production plants — Wellerstein/Brookings) for pf-industry; historiographic consensus (war decisive for TEMPO ~0.85, base discrepancies[2]) for the split between physics-content and state-realization. Confidence on every share <=0.6. novel_residue is conceptually the gain_v2 synergy quantity — NO gain_v2 bits exist for this specimen; never render these as measured bits.

pf-fission.basis: the physics content — necessary but alone moved at peacetime tempo (German negative control); historiographic-consensus estimate, conf ~0.55

pf-med.basis: command, AA-1 priority, secrecy, site-building — the realization arm; estimate conf ~0.5

pf-industry.basis: production plants took >80% of ~$2bn spend (the strongest data-anchored share here, but spend != load-bearing, so still an estimate, conf ~0.6)

pf-osrd.basis: the science-mobilization method that made it a national program; estimate conf ~0.5

pf-universities.basis: the contract-research form that staffed Los Alamos/Met Lab; estimate conf ~0.5

pf-tubealloys.basis: MAUD feasibility-proof catalyst that fired the weld (catalytic, not mass-bearing); estimate conf ~0.55

novel_residue.basis: the joint synergy neither parent predicts: 33-month tempo / wartime industrializability (base 'surprise', surprise_confidence 0.8) + the template-unifier byproduct ('a Manhattan Project for ___'); conceptually the gain_v2 quantity, rendered as a disclosed estimate conf ~0.5
